sources.name: x264-source.tar.gz
sources.upstream_version: API 164; build version 0.164.x (source supplied without Git history)
sources.provenance_note: All 270 file paths and file contents match the official commit byte for byte. Comparison used git archive with core.autocrlf=false; no line-ending normalization was needed.

build.configuration: Static Windows x86_64 build; FFmpeg GPL and version 3 enabled; libx264 enabled; autodetection disabled; HEVC encoder, decoder, parser, HEVC-specific bitstream filters, raw demuxer and muxer disabled; x265 not included.

verification.details: Hashes were recomputed on 2026-11-01 and match the build audit's SHA256SUMS. App tests use the new candidate; stock FFmpeg is used only to generate test inputs. HEVC inputs were copied unchanged with zero encoding calls. The existing vendor binaries were not replaced.

distribution_caveats: This manifest records file identity and build inputs; it is not legal advice or confirmation that redistribution is permitted.
This manifest describes the new independent build, not the older binaries still present under vendor/ffmpeg-windows.
